conclusion: The phase 1 LPAC assumption was not tested. The sandbox denied creation of the requested test root; the approved execution outside the sandbox had an elevated Windows token and the script stopped before creating any fixtures or profile.

failure.message: Parent is elevated; refusing to run.

design_source: Existing local ecosystem-ops checkout; requested git pull was rejected by automatic approval review.
script_note: After these runs the script was adjusted to stage its child script in the granted directory and clean up an unexpectedly successful sibling write; no further LPAC attempt was made.
